from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792486032/attempts/84bcef3cf5a14479a7d0101da055aebf/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    row_seps = [r for r in range(h) if grid[r] and grid[r][0] != 0 and all(v == grid[r][0] for v in grid[r])]
    col_seps = [c for c in range(w) if grid[0][c] != 0 and all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h))]
    def intervals(n, seps):
        out=[]; start=0
        for x in seps:
            if x > start: out.append((start,x))
            start=x+1
        if start<n: out.append((start,n))
        return out
    rs, cs = intervals(h,row_seps), intervals(w,col_seps)
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    tiles={}
    for i,(a,b) in enumerate(rs):
        for j,(c,d) in enumerate(cs):
            vals=[grid[r][k] for r in range(a,b) for k in range(c,d) if grid[r][k]!=0]
            colors=set(vals)
            tiles[i,j]=(next(iter(colors)) if len(colors)==1 else None, b-a, d-c)
    fills=[]
    for i in range(len(rs)-1):
        for j in range(len(cs)-1):
            positions=[(i,j),(i,j+1),(i+1,j),(i+1,j+1)]
            sizes={(tiles[p][1],tiles[p][2]) for p in positions}
            if len(sizes)!=1: continue
            colors=[tiles[p][0] for p in positions]
            nonzero=[x for x in colors if x is not None]
            if len(nonzero)!=3 or len(set(nonzero))!=1: continue
            missing=colors.index(None)
            mi,mj=positions[missing]
            si,sj=positions[3-missing]
            color=nonzero[0]
            ra,rb=rs[mi]; ca,cb=cs[mj]
            sa,sb=rs[si]; sc,sd=cs[sj]
            # The missing tile is the double reflection of its diagonal partner.
            for dr in range(rb-ra):
                for dc in range(cb-ca):
                    val=grid[sa+(sb-sa-1-dr)][sc+(sd-sc-1-dc)]
                    if val != 0:
                        fills.append((ra+dr,ca+dc,color))
    for r,c,color in fills: out[r][c]=color
    return out
'''
path=programs/'task-7c20a8bd.py'
path.write_text(source)
print(path)
